# Dependency injection errors and warnings

Diagnostics reported by Metalama.Extensions.DependencyInjection.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama0701> | A dependency can't be handled because no dependency injection framework is registered. |
| <xref:lama0702> | None of the registered dependency injection frameworks can handle a dependency, for instance a static one. |
| <xref:lama0703> | The [IntroduceDependency] advice is used in an aspect applied to a declaration that isn't a type or a type member. |
| <xref:lama0704> | The type of a dependency is less accessible than the constructor that would receive it. |
